About Cyfamod SMS

Cyfamod SMS is a school management system for records, attendance, results, staff, classes, communication, and school operations.

What you will do

  • Promote Cyfamod SMS to schools.
  • Generate and follow up on leads.
  • Build relationships with school decision-makers.
  • Support conversion and onboarding for acquired schools.

What we expect

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Access to school owners, administrators, or education networks.
  • Professional representation of Cyfamod Technologies.
  • Consistent follow-up until prospects convert or close.

Compensation

  • ₦100,000 for every 9 schools acquired in a month.
  • ₦200 per student is the standard term pricing.
  • Markup incentive: keep the first-term difference above ₦200 per student.
  • Example: ₦500 per student pays ₦300 extra per student for the first term only.
